actions.name: goto
actions.about: Open an http(s) page in the browser widget (opens the widget if needed). Reading it marks the conversation.

actions.name: snapshot
actions.about: The page as text, with [eN] refs on links, buttons and fields. Marks the conversation (the page is untrusted).

actions.name: click
actions.about: Click the element with that ref (from the last snapshot).

actions.name: type
actions.about: Type text into the field with that ref (end the text with \n to press Enter).
